map.A/B 测试显著性：两比例 z 检验，z =（pA − pB）÷ √[p̂(1: A/B test significance: two-proportion z test, z = (pA − pB) / sqrt[p̂(1 − p̂)(1/nA + 1/nB)], where p̂ is the pooled conversion rate; the z value is looked up on the standard normal to get the p value, and p below 0.05 means the difference is significant.

map.A 组 200/2000=10%，B 组 260/2000=13%，两比例 z≈: Group A 200/2000 = 10% and group B 260/2000 = 13% gives z ≈ 2.45 and two-sided p ≈ 0.014 < 0.05, so the difference is significant at 95% confidence and B can be rolled out in full.
map.若 p>0.05（如只差 0.5 个百分点且样本小），结论为「尚不显著」，应继续: If p > 0.05 (for example only a 0.5 percentage point gap with a small sample), the conclusion is "not yet significant"; keep collecting data or expand the sample rather than rolling out hastily.
map.p<0.05 就一定该推吗？: Does p < 0.05 always justify a rollout?
